workload.order: alternating old/new; paired same binary, no other builds running
workload.includes: warm in-memory hashing only; no file IO/startup/model inference

limitations: Single Apple Silicon machine; no cross-platform performance guarantee. Both digests compared for exact equality before timing.
benchmark_manifest:
[package]
name = "tiptoptyp-sha2-benchmark"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
[dependencies]
old_sha2 = { package = "sha2", version = "=0.10.9", features = ["asm"] }
new_sha2 = { package = "sha2", version = "=0.11.1" }
[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
[workspace]
